overview.description: The GraniteShares YieldBOOST MARA ETF (MAAY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is actively managed seeking current income and the daily 2x leverage of the price performance of MARA Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: MARA) MAAY was launched on Nov 4, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
